raw_segments.text: Nathless he so endured, till on the beach of that inflamed sea he stood, and called
his legions Angel Forms, who lay entranced thick as autumnal leaves that strow the brooks
in Valimbrosa, where th, Etrurian shades high overarched and bower.
Or scattered sedge afloat, when with fierce winds Orion-armed hath vexed the Red Sea coast,
